The convocation of autonomous programs (Post-graduate and Diploma) came to a conclusion in presence of eminent personalities attending the event held at WeSchool campus. The convocation ceremony was held for students of WeSchool autonomous programs from different areas of management such as Marketing, HR, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, E-biz, Healthcare, Retail, IT, etc. The curriculum of autonomous programs focuses on developing and upgrading the management quotient of students. Taking into account the needs and aspirations of working professionals and freshers, the curriculum is designed to help them establish a strong foothold in different industrial sectors.

The convocation certificates were presented to graduating students by Prof. Dr. [**Uday Salunkhe**](http://www.udaysalunkhe.co.in/uday-salunkhe.php), Group Director of [**Welingkar**](http://www.udaysalunkhewelingkar.co.in/) Institute of Management Development and Research and Shri Dattatray Padsalgikar (IPS), Commissioner of Mumbai Police. Among other eminent personalities present at the event were Shri Sohanlal Jain, Chairman, Shri Shrikrishna Chitale, Vice-Chairman, Smt. Madhuri Misal, Managing body member, and Shikshan Prasarak Mandali, the founding trust of WeSchool.

Dr. Uday Salunkhe addressed the students, “Design your own future. Make learning, unlearning and relearning a continuous part of your life’s journey. Don’t be happy with the status quo, pursue excellence, and continuously raise the bar. In the journey of innovation, failures are bound to be there but celebrate failures as learning from failures is infinite. Transform self, and become instruments of change in the organization and society,”

Applauding WeSchool’s efforts in training the middle level managerial talent, Shri Dattatray Padsalgikar said, “Your generation is fortunate as you have every information available to you at the click of a key. And you as students know how to leverage it to stay ahead in the race. Adopt an Innovative approach to take you beyond normal studies, contribute to social responsibility by giving government services a chance as these too are great opportunities for you to contribute to society and nation. Your management skills will contribute greatly to government’s strengths.”

Shri Sohanlal and Shri Shrikrishna Chitale shared their wisdom with the students urging them to find a perfect balance between career and social responsibilities. Students must learn to manage the stress in business and take up challenges head-on and contribute time for nation building activity.

The need for skilled managers and executives is rising. This rise has created a need for strong and steady pipeline of managers in the corporate sector in India. To meet this demand, WeSchool attempts to provide domain expertise and help students master new skills, explore diverse perspectives and develop a leadership style to transform organizations and carry them to newer levels.

WeSchool and Mumbai Police force collaborate on various initiatives for sensitizing young school and college students to societal issues. ‘Safe Women Safe Nation’ is one such program working to safeguard today’s women for a better tomorrow. The seminar provides training and development to over 200 women.
